requirement_vague: Verify profile returns correct bio and image fields
requirement_precise: Create user1 (username: 'profilebiouser1', email: 'profilebiouser1@test.com', password: 'pass123'). Update user1's profile with bio 'This is my bio text' and image 'https://example.com/avatar.jpg' via PUT /api/user. GET /api/profiles/profilebiouser1. Verify the profile contains username 'profilebiouser1', bio 'This is my bio text', and image 'https://example.com/avatar.jpg'. This tests profile data retrieval.

implementation.reasoning: The PUT /api/user handler updates the authenticated user's bio and image fields and commits them to the database. The GET /api/profiles/{username} handler returns a profile built by profile_dict, which includes username, bio, and image from the stored user record, so the updated values are retrieved correctly.
